POV: You work in tech, spend all day looking at screens, and still want to hit your protein goals and eat healthy. 💻🍝 Because surviving a busy 9–5 shouldn’t mean surviving on takeout! This creamy salmon, tomato & feta pasta is my kind of weekday meal prep. Easy to make, delicious, and ready for the week. 🍝 Ingredients (5 servings) * 14 oz Atlantic salmon * 224 g fusilli pasta * 224 g feta cheese * 279 g cherry tomatoes * 100 g chopped spinach * Garlic, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning & chili flakes * Olive oil (optional) 👩🏻‍🍳 Recipe 1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). 2. Add cherry tomatoes and feta to a baking dish. Season with garlic, salt, pepper, Italian seasoning and olive oil. 3. Bake for 25–30 minutes until tomatoes burst and feta softens. 4. Season and bake salmon separately until cooked through. 5. Cook pasta according to package instructions. 6. Stir spinach into the baked feta and tomato mixture until wilted. 7. Flake in the salmon, add pasta and mix everything together. 8. Divide into 5 containers and you’re meal-prepped for the week! ✨ Makes: 5 servings 🔥 Calories: ~417 per serving (based on tracked ingredients) A little planning goes a long way when you’re balancing a full-time tech job, workouts and everything else life throws at you.
